title: helianthemum serpillifolium
intro: Helianthemum serpillifolium, commonly known as downy rockrose or smallflower rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum serpillifolium include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for treating skin conditions and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
